title: actions.json Schema Comparison
source_material: Private Amazon Prime Video carousel action map and run log, generalized without item titles or URLs
purpose: Compare the design brief's cartographic/state-machine schema principles with the schema draft's prototype-derived catalog proposal.

visibility.promotion_reason: Schema comparison report approved for linking from planning tools and the schema draft.

key_findings: The schema draft is strong as a tool catalog and bridge vocabulary.
The design brief requires stronger runtime cartography, state traversal, testability, composition, and protocol binding layers.

The Amazon carousel prototype showed that visible-card diagnostics, horizontal scroll transitions, rate limits, reveal semantics, result merging, and convergence conditions need structured schema support.
The next schema iteration should add states, transitions, preconditions, reveals, imports, checks, contingencies, and Responses-style bindings without discarding the schema draft.
